description: This routine is designed to gently cleanse and hydrate sensitive skin while preparing it for the day ahead.

morning_steps.purpose: To remove any overnight oil and impurities without irritating the skin.
To lock in moisture and provide a barrier against environmental factors.

morning_steps.action: Moisturized skin, apply sunscreen with at least SPF 30.
morning_steps.purpose: To protect the skin from UV damage and further irritation.

night_steps.action: Gently cleanse the face using a non-irritating cleanser.
night_steps.purpose: To remove makeup, dirt, and impurities that have accumulated throughout the day.

night_steps.action: Apply a hydrating serum or treatment cream targeted to specific skin concerns like hyperpigmentation or fine lines.
night_steps.purpose: To target specific issues and provide additional nourishment overnight.

night_steps.action: Finish with a hydrating night moisturizer suitable for sensitive skin types.
night_steps.purpose: To ensure the skin is properly hydrated while you sleep, promoting recovery and repair.

weekly_steps.action: Exfoliate with a gentle chemical exfoliant.

do: Use lukewarm water when cleansing the face.
Patch test new products before full application.
dont: Avoid using harsh, alcohol-based toners or scrubs.
Do not skip sunscreen on cloudy days as UV rays penetrate clouds.
common_mistakes: Using products with fragrances can irritate sensitive skin; opt for fragrance-free alternatives.
Over-exfoliation can damage the delicate skin barrier, leading to increased sensitivity and redness.

expected_results.2_weeks: Skin appears more hydrated and less red or irritated.
expected_results.1_month: Significant reduction in dryness, flakiness, and overall sensitivity.
expected_results.3_months: Visible improvement in skin texture with a noticeable reduction in fine lines or discoloration.

expert_tips: Always follow up your sunscreen application by applying moisturizer to seal in the protection without causing irritation.
Stay hydrated from within by drinking plenty of water and eating foods rich in antioxidants.
